title: AER Hardware Migration & Ghost Handover Schema
description: Cryptographically authenticated migration manifest transferring machine soul/vault control between physical silicon units (AER Appendix C.3).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

account_id.description: ERC-4337 smart contract account address holding accumulated Credit B and reputation history.

migration_type.description: Migration modality: GRACEFUL (bilateral handshake + zeroization) or EMERGENCY (destroyed chassis with M-of-N guild witnesses).

old_node_id.description: Ethereum address of the retiring or destroyed silicon hardware unit.

new_node_id.description: Ethereum address of the newly commissioned silicon hardware unit.

new_tpm_attestation.description: Full hardware attestation payload of the new target machine.

zeroization_proof.description: Cryptographic proof that the old signing keys were permanently zeroized inside the old TPM (mandatory for GRACEFUL).

old_node_signature.description: ECDSA signature from the old node approving migration (required in GRACEFUL).

new_node_signature.description: ECDSA signature from the new node accepting soul stewardship.

guild_witness_signatures.description: M-of-N attestation signatures from peer guild nodes (mandatory in EMERGENCY).

challenge_timelock_deadline.description: Mandatory quarantine window timestamp (+7 days in emergency mode) allowing the original owner to veto fraudulent claims.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds when the migration ticket was finalized.
